However, some front teeth might need grinding and a visit to a periodontist, and the upper right tooth was starting to decay. They told me to wait for the scaling. In total, I paid 1,200 baht for the X-rays.

While waiting for the scaling and filling, the staff mentioned the periodontist wouldn't be back in three days and asked if I wanted to do everything at once. I agreed and scheduled an appointment to save time.

I arrived at my appointment at 6:30 PM. The staff asked me to fill out a form with questions about my appointment, even though they had called me beforehand. Then, they seemed to be reviewing my appointment slip. They quoted prices for various services: scaling 800-1500 baht, fillings 200-300 baht per side, and drilling 200-300 baht. We agreed.

Then, they came back and asked the doctor to take an additional X-ray of the upper right tooth, even though we were still sitting at the counter and hadn't even been put on the chair yet. They also said they could only do one thing at a time and couldn't do everything. But we'd already had the X-ray! We were getting annoyed, and the staff started getting rude. So we said, "Then just do the scaling." They even made us wait!

In the end, we canceled the scaling and asked for the first X-ray film back. The staff suddenly softened and spoke nicely, but we wasted a lot of time and felt very disappointed. Goodbye.
